note: Durations are [ESTIMATE] (planning figures, not measured): they assume one maintainer and the existing release cadence. Gates are the binding part: a stage is complete only when its gate check passes. Stage numbering follows docs/MIGRATION_PLAN.md. Compatibility matrix keys: old = verifiers that only understand classical signatures; new = verifiers that understand the hybrid envelope; mixed = a fleet with both.

stages.gate: A signed release exists (Ed25519, the current classical scheme) whose signature and SHA-256 checksum are published alongside the release, and a verifier script that checks both is published in the repo. Gate check: scripts/check_measurements.py-style independent re-verification of a published release passes.
stages.name: Sign what exists today
work: Publish an Ed25519 signature + SHA-256 checksum file with every GitHub release (the release job currently publishes neither).
Publish a verifier script in the repo that checks signature + checksum against the release tag.
Pin Docker images by digest in the deployment docs; stop telling operators to pull mutable -latest tags.

stages.gate: The hybrid envelope format (versioned header + algorithm identifiers + classical half + PQ half) is specified in docs/HYBRID_DESIGN.md, and harness/hybrid_bench.c demonstrates a hybrid signature that verifies only when both halves verify (controls C-1..C-5 all PASS). Gate check: reproduce.sh passes, including the hybrid controls.
stages.name: Hybrid envelope, dual-sign in parallel
work: Freeze the hybrid envelope format (H-1 concatenated dual signature, Ed25519 + ML-DSA-44).
Sign every release twice: classical (Ed25519) and hybrid (Ed25519 + ML-DSA-44); publish both signatures.
Ship a verifier that understands the hybrid envelope and falls back to classical-only with an explicit warning, never silently.

stages.gate: All supported verifiers (operator tooling, install docs, CI checks) accept hybrid signatures and reject a stripped (classical-only) hybrid envelope. Gate check: the C-4 downgrade control in harness/hybrid_bench.c is mirrored by an operator-tooling test that rejects a stripped envelope.
stages.name: Verifiers require the PQ half
work: Update operator tooling and install docs to require the PQ half for releases at or above the cutover version.
Add a policy flag: before the cutover version, classical-only is accepted with a warning; at/after it, classical-only is rejected.
Publish the cutover version and date in the release notes.

stages.gate: No supported release is classical-only; the release job fails if either half is missing. Key rotation is exercised once on a test release (old key revoked, new key published, verifiers pick it up). Gate check: a dry-run release with a missing PQ half fails the job; a rotated key verifies.
stages.name: Classical-only retired for new releases
work: Make the release job fail closed when either signature half is missing.
Exercise the key-rotation procedure (docs/ROLLBACK_KEY_COMPROMISE.md) on a test release.
Keep verifying old classical-only releases (they remain valid for their versions; they are not retroactively re-signed).

stages.gate: Annual review: re-measure algorithm performance on current hardware, re-check NIST/IETF status of ML-DSA and SLH-DSA, and re-evaluate the parameter choice (ML-DSA-44 vs 65/87, ML-DSA vs SLH-DSA). Gate check: a dated review note is published with the re-measured numbers.
stages.name: Review and re-evaluate
work: Re-run this pack's benchmarks on current hardware and compare with outputs/benchmark-pq.log.
Track NIST/IETF hybrid-signature standards (composite signatures, CNSA 2.0 timelines) and adopt a standard envelope when one stabilises.
Re-evaluate ML-DSA-65/87 if the threat model changes.
